title: Flow (src/flows/<id>.yaml)
$comment: Validated on load by scripts/lint_flows.py. Schema introduced in road-to-6.1.0 Step 8b (ADR-055). This schema fixes the SHAPE of a flow file; referential integrity (every entry_point / default_path entry resolves to a real command, every skill resolves to a real skill, id == filename stem, id is in the closed flow set) is enforced by the lint, not the schema — the same shape-vs-resolution split pack.schema.json + validate_pack_yaml.py use.

id.description: Flow id — lowercase slug, must equal the filename stem. The closed flow set {discovery, implementation, review, delivery} is enforced by lint_flows.py, not this schema (a new flow is a curated governance decision, not a free addition).

summary.description: One- or two-sentence answer to "what am I trying to do?" — the journey, not a command list.

entry_points.description: Commands that START the flow (the daily front doors). Each must resolve to a real command via resolve_logical("commands/<ref>.md").

default_path.description: The canonical command sequence for the flow, in order. Each must resolve to a real command.

skills.description: Skills the flow composes end-to-end. Each must resolve to a real skills/<slug>/SKILL.md.

commands.description: Optional descriptive seed list lifted from the command-classification worksheet `·_flow:` tags. Annotation only — entry_points / default_path are the validated reference fields. Each entry, if present, must still resolve to a real command.

commandRef.description: A logical command path — a top-level stem (`work`) or a cluster sub (`fix/pr-comments`, `pr/create`). Resolved by resolve_logical("commands/<ref>.md").
